heads.t: 相伴，就是最好的風景 2026/11/02 歲月匆匆，走過人生一段路之後，才發現旅行的意義，早已和年輕時不太一樣。 年輕時出門，總想著要多去幾個地方、多看幾處風景，行程排得滿滿的，深怕錯過什麼。如今再出發，反而喜歡把腳步放慢。遇見喜歡的景色就停一停，累了就找個地方坐一坐，不再追著時間跑，也不再計較一天究竟去了多少景點。 這次旅途中，我們來到古塔前。高大的古塔靜靜矗立在綠樹之間，走過漫長歲月，依然保留著古樸而沉穩的模樣。 站在塔下抬頭望去，忽然覺得，人和一座古塔相比，人生真的只是短短的一程。於是，我們在塔前留下了一張合照。照片裡沒有特別漂亮的衣服，也沒有刻意安排的姿勢，只是很自然地靠在一起。…
heads.en: Together, it's the best view, 2026/11/02, and it's only a little bit of time before you realize what travel is like when you're young. When I was young, I wanted to go to a few more places, to see a few more scenes, to be busy, to be afraid of missing something. Now we go again and we like to slow down. If you're tired, you're tired and you're not chasing the time, and you're not counting on how many places you've gone. On this journey, we come to Guta. And the towers of the towers stood still between the green trees, walking long and long, and still remained as old and steady. Standing under a tower, looking up, suddenly feeling that life is really a short distance from a tower. So we left a photo in front of the tower. There are no particularly beautiful clothes in the picture, nor any deliberate pose, but it's natural to lean together. I don't know.

heads.t: 夢回東台重遊西溪唐塔 2026/11/02 明洪武廿年（1387），朱元璋命江夏侯周德興來閩督建衛、所，次年在浯洲建置守禦千戶所，以有「固若金湯、雄鎮海門」之勢，名曰「金門城」，這也是金門得名的由來。 相傳周德興在築城同時也建有三座以條石壘成，型制大致相同的石塔，即太武山「倒影塔」、南磐山「文台寶塔」和水頭金龜山「茅山塔」。 地方上對這三座石塔有一些傳說，一說都是做為航海指標，二說是庇佑士林科舉連捷，三說是洪武帝偶聞東南海上有天子之氣，才指派周侯南下建塔鎮壓，毀壞逐鹿天下的好地理。事隔六百多年，真相因年湮代遠，難以探究大白。…

As the sock rises by more than 30%, the price of buying a "one-priced medal" continues to rise, many brands are going up, and the fine-counting of Japanese purchases becomes even more important. In Japan, UNIQLO recently announced an 11/10 increase in commodity prices, which averaged about 4 per cent, with socks rising by 34.5 per cent, drawing attention to Taiwan's consumers. However, in the midst of the rise in the number of brands, local utility brand WORKMAN announced that it would lower the price in reverse, causing a number of insiders to praise "CP values high" as an unexpected focus of discussion. One hour ago, Japan's UNIQLO was about to become more expensive!

heads.t: 謝霆鋒演唱會被丟螢光棒！男子荒唐辯「喜歡才扔」 下場曝光 謝霆鋒《Evolution Nic Live 謝霆鋒進化演唱會》溫州站於10月31日至11月1日在大陸溫州奧林匹克體育中心舉行，沒想到10月31日演出期間，一名白衣男觀眾突然朝台上的謝霆鋒丟擲螢光棒，遭現場歌迷上前質問時，竟辯稱是「發自內心喜歡才扔」，引發網友怒火。對此，溫州市公安局龍灣區分局及文旅主管部門於11月1日證實，已依法對涉事男子毛某作出行政處罰；毛某已透過主辦方向藝人及其團隊道歉並取得對方諒解。 26 分鐘前｜娛樂 謝霆鋒演唱會被丟螢光棒！男子荒唐辯「喜歡才扔」 下場曝光 26 分鐘前｜娛樂
heads.en: Thank you for losing the bat! On October 31st and November 1st, at the Olympia Sports Center in Winn State, Grand Land, it was unexpected that during the performance of October 31st, a white man who suddenly threw a glitter on the stage and was questioned in front of a fan of the scene, was arguing that he was "slave only because he liked it" and causing an anger among his friends. For that reason, the police department of Winzhou City, the Department of Dragon Bay District and the Ministry of Mandarin, On November 1, it was confirmed that administrative punishment had been imposed on the men involved; Mao had apologized and obtained forgiveness from the leading artist and his team. 26 minutes ago, the Xinjiang concert was thrown out!
